title: Machining centres
subtitle: Dener TMC vertical machining centres, BBT40, X 33.5 – 63″ · TDC double-column machining centres, BBT50, X 82.7 – 161.4″
about_title: Vertical and double-column machining centres from Dener's machine-tool plant
about_text: The TMC vertical machining centres mill, drill, bore and tap in one setup on stress-relieved Meehanite castings laid out by finite-element analysis: a direct-drive BBT40 spindle at 10,000 rpm (12,000 or 15,000 to order), a 24-tool arm changer, double-nut C3 ballscrews and roller guides traversing at 1,417 in/min (36 m/min), positioning to ±0.00016″ (±0.004 mm). Five sizes from the TMC 850 with 33.5 × 20.1 × 22″ travels to the TMC 1600 with 63 × 27.6 × 27.6″. The TDC double-column machining centres carry the spindle on a cross rail between two columns for long, wide and heavy parts: BBT50 at 10,000 rpm with through-spindle coolant, 82.7 to 161.4″ of X travel and tables for up to 26,455 lb (12,000 kg).

Dener Makina has built machinery in Kayseri since 1974, and since 2016 CNC machine tools in the Taksan plant it took over: 155,000 m² of factory buildings where the castings are machined and the machines assembled. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the machining centres in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, with a CSA-approved panel and a 1-year warranty.
